scope: Isolated preview only; no production/main or real delivery

checks: all previous QA schemas retain every table count and row fingerprint
the original synthetic historical manifest, wastes and events remain unchanged
actual API/static processes keep CAP expired and every external delivery gate closed; relay does nothing and mail has zero attempts
compiled mail source checks against real PostgreSQL reject replaced inspectors and retain current assignments without sending
inspection intake preserves canonical evidence, source links and decisions without repeated origins or GPS secrets

runtime sources match the tested immutable builds; QA manual matches its source snapshot and bundles do not point at production
one CPU and two GiB without swap or OOM maintained

note: Reports of interrupted attempts retained. A later passing run supersedes the same file/project/title. Directed unit counts are not added to complete-suite counts. Browser profiles do not certify physical devices.
